card.name: Left or right in photo captions
card.fires_on: The words "left" and "right" when they give a position in a photo caption, such as "(right)", "From left" or "pictured right". It fires most in parentheses after a person's name.

modes.label: Parenthetical after a name
modes.description: "right" or "left" in brackets after a person's name, showing where they stand in the picture.

modes.label: Pictured or from left
modes.description: "left" or "right" after "pictured", "from" or "lower" in a caption.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the words left and right that tell you where someone or something sits in a photo caption.
